name: Shenzhen MTC Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen MTC Co., Ltd. specializes in the design, development, manufacturing, and distribution of a wide array of electronic products, encompassing LCD televisions, set-top boxes, LED lighting solutions, networking equipment, and various internet entertainment products and related services. The company additionally delivers services such as smart manufacturing, digital entertainment, and general consumer support. For its consumer electronics, it employs the brand names FunTV and MTC Lighting. Founded in 2005, the firm is based in Shenzhen, China.
